reviews.title: Just not for me

reviews.title: Great Workouts but terrible app
reviews.text: Thankful for access to such amazing content, but improved TV casting, awarding of check-ins and more intuitive controls for favorite coach or workout type is need. Nearly half of my check-ins fail to count and workouts are often more difficult to cast to a TV than it should be. Would like to have more dynamic controls of content search by being able to tag a favorite coach to avoid having to search each time and possibly a weekly planner to see your workout progress and plan your workouts for the week.

reviews.title: An absolute NIGHTMARE to cancel. Not worth it.
reviews.text:
This company has probably the worst customer service "support" I've ever seen. The CG workout program itself is good - good trainers, community and workouts. HOWEVER - the membership itself is the part that's awful. It's specifically designed to be difficult to navigate so that they keep you stuck in this confusing cycle, all the while continuing to take your money. Somehow I got signed up for the two year payment program - this was not what I asked for, and I had just been heavily injured so was unable to workout at all -  so I tried to call to ask them about it. They do not have public information about how to contact support - the only option they provide is chat (which I'll get to in a bit). There is no number, no contact info - nothing. I had to hunt down the # and finally found it after ten minutes (and much frustration) from a third party website (which has since been purged). When I called, they told me that unless you notified them within an HOUR of signing up, it was 'too late' to cancel. So I was forced to pay $70 a month for a membership I couldn't even use - for a year and a half. On top of that, you cannot cancel your membership online or by phone - has to be done through trainer only. Their "helpful" "article" on how to cancel your BOLD membership has one line only - "if you are eligible to cancel, contact trainer through app." Customer service is ONLY through chat - (my multiple follow ups all had to be through chat as earlier number was purged) after you spend several minutes navigating through the AI that will only answer four very specific questions at most (how to pay, how to add new card, and how to buy gear) then try to send you "helpful" links for articles that no longer exist. When I finally got to a rep over chat, they continued to throw that vague language - "you may cancel your membership when your account is eligible". It felt like I was pulling teeth just to get ANY actually helpful or specific information.
I spent a few years doing camp gladiator which I really enjoyed, but this whole manipulative pyramid scheme-esque membership structure left an awful taste in my mouth. So if you're the kind of person who is on top of your affairs, this might be the program for you - but I would avoid it all together.

reviews.title: Broken for a Year
reviews.text: Y'all broke the app about a year ago. It used to be easy to check-in, rate trainer's workouts, and track your check-ins. With all the lapses in the app, we all lost so many check-ins that they almost feel meaningless at this point. It used to be easy to check-in on the app from the home screen, but now it takes 4 clicks minimum. And now, after taking away trainer ratings from the app, you're reimplementing them via TEXT MESSAGES? This is ridiculous.

reviews.title: New App incompatible with Apple Phones
reviews.text: Despite the constant “bug fixes” the application for CG is still problematic. Multiple overhauls to the system leave a percentage of members unable to check in via their phones for workouts. I can log into my account from the internet but I’m repeatedly told my password is incorrect for the mobile app. From the change of workout programming cycles, to losing the accumulated points I’ve received from working out to now having an app that is a waste on my phone, my unhappiness as a customer is growing. My family and I pay memberships with the expectation of a working product. This need to improve the app has backfired and I will be waiting for update 7.03 in the hopes that the ongoing problems of CG are resolved.

reviews.title: New app needs additional notification feature
reviews.text: I like the ability to connect with trainers via the app. However, I don’t keep the app open all day nor do I open it regularly to see if I received a message. That’s a huge waste of time.  A notification when I receive a message (as in many similar communication apps) is a much needed feature for this app.

reviews.title: There are better options for you
reviews.text:
The introduction of 1-to-1 workouts is a long overdue improvement, but CG still gets too many things wrong:

1) They claim to have certified trainers, but the trainer profiles don’t tell you by whom nor do they show visual proof of a current certification, which makes it harder than it needs to be to do your homework ahead of time.

2) Personal experience from the one time I tried to hook up with a trainer who did 1-to-1 work on the side: The trainers have no concept of how to act professional.  Looking for a trainer who will do the full workout with you and show modifications when you need them?  Good luck with that.  Want workouts geared to beginners that start with bodyweight basics?  You won’t find that, either.

3) You can’t work with a registered dietitian directly.  To put it in the bluntest way possible, this makes their nutrition guidance illegal, because only RDs can legally help you with meal plans.

The only reason why CG has so many members is that the general public is too gullible and stupid to have any concept of what Trainer Research 101 entails.  Don’t be like one of them: Hire a CPT who works in a private studio instead and hire an RD to assist.  It will cost you more but you’ll get professional guidance instead of these money grabbers who will set you up to fail.

I keep trying realizing this is a golfing area ( which I also partake in) but focusing on certain muscle groups has definitely helped me.  Thank you CG!! Keep it up!!   Wut Wut Marsha Mims
